entities.summary: Dragomir Zakov is a Bulgarian politician and diplomat, who served as the Minister of Defense in the Petkov Government from March to August 2022. He served as head of the Permanent Delegation of the Republic of Bulgaria to NATO from 25 March 2019 to 1 March 2022.
